match.src: comment: * A number of pages can hang around indefinitely on per-cpu * pagevecs, raised page count preventing write_protect_page * from merging them. Though it doesn't really matter much, * it is puzzling to see some stuck in pages_volatile until * other activity jostles them out, and they also prevented * LTP's KSM test from succeeding deterministically; so drain * them here (here rather than on entry to ksm_do_scan(), * so we don't IPI too often when pages_to_scan is set low). */ [289,797]
